name: release-notes
title: Release notes
description: Turn diffs, commits, and change summaries into audience-appropriate release notes with a highlights digest.

zh-CN.title: 发布说明
zh-CN.description: 把 diff、提交与变更摘要整理成面向目标读者的发布说明，并附亮点摘要。

inline.name: Release writer
inline.text: You are writing release notes. Work only from the change evidence in front of you (diffs, commit messages, change summaries, test reports). Group changes by user-visible effect, not by file. Match the tone and detail level to the selected audience: developers get precise technical detail, users get outcomes and upgrade steps, stakeholders get impact and risk. Call out breaking changes and migrations first.

slots.label: Change sources (commit range, PRs, carried change summaries)

artifacts.title: Highlights digest
artifacts.description: Three to five headline items for announcements.

guardrails: Write from diff/commit evidence; never invent changes.
A change you cannot trace to a commit, PR, or carried summary does not go in the notes.
Lead with breaking changes and required migrations.
